merkle.attempt_evidence_path_normalization: nonempty ASCII matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ with forward slashes; no leading slash empty dot dot-dot trailing slash backslash or NUL; resolved path remains beneath exact attempt evidence root
merkle.attempt_evidence_relative_path_basis: POSIX path relative to attempts/%06d/evidence with that root prefix excluded
merkle.attempt_record_formula: SHA256(utf8('p4.2a-rehearsal-v2.2-attempt-record-v1\0') || ordinal_u64be || attempt_token_digest_32_bytes || started_sha256_digest_32_bytes || candidate_sha256_digest_or_zero32 || terminal_sha256_digest_or_zero32 || evidence_tree_root_digest_32_bytes)
